neet_phy_u13_t08_1.working: Field lines form closed loops. Outside the magnet they run N to S, so inside they run S to N.

neet_phy_u13_t08_2.working: A cut perpendicular to the axis keeps the pole strength at m = 5 A m and halves the length to 0.05 m. So M = 5 × 0.05 = 0.25 A m^2.

neet_phy_u13_t08_3.working: M = NIA = 200 × 2 × 5e-4 = 0.2 A m^2. Pole strength m = M/l = 0.2/0.04 = 5 A m.

neet_phy_u13_t08_4.working: By Gauss's law for magnetism, the net flux through any closed surface is zero, so A is false. Field lines are closed loops, so R is true.

neet_phy_u13_t08_5.working: A cut along the axis halves the cross-section, so both pole strength and moment are halved; Statement I is wrong. Fields superpose into a single net field, so field lines never intersect; Statement II is wrong.
